title: Pure Ragnaraika
summary: Ragnaraika cards only, with generic staples. The Ragnaraika are Insects, Plants and Reptiles that summon themselves by banishing or returning each other, and their Link Monsters return from the GY by putting one of your monsters on the bottom of the Deck, so the Links keep coming back. Ragnaraika the Evil Seed summons itself by sending a monster and adds two Ragnaraika cards from the Deck or banishment, and Ragnaraika Bloom searches or revives one every turn. The Links climb from Skeletal Soldier through Mantis Monk to Stag Sovereign, which destroys two monsters whenever the opponent summons from the Deck or Extra Deck. Ragnaraika Hunting Dance destroys a card for each Type among your Links. Wicked Butterfly, Selene Snapper and Wisteria of Woe, from late 2024, are the newest cards.
